newsitem.title: USA: Wash Water restores power to more customers.
newsitem.headline: Wash Water restores power to more customers.

text.p: Between 25,000 and 30,000 Washington Water Power Co electricity customers, most of which are in the Spokane area, were still without service early Friday after heavy rains and snow damaged transmission lines Tuesday, the company said.
As of 0530 PST Friday, the company said 10 distribution feeders out of the total 47 originally damaged were still without service in the Spokane area. The utility has a total of 109 feeders.
The Blue Creek substation in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, has also returned to service, the company said. About 2,400 customers were still without service in this area.
About 100,000 customers were initially affected on Tuesday afternoon by the 23 downed high-voltage transmission lines.
The company said crews would continue to make repairs to damaged lines over the weekend and into next week.
Washington Water Power services eastern Washington and northern Idaho.
